question: Which deity is proclaimed as the presiding power of this mantra?
premises: The mantra has a presiding deity.
That deity is named as Mṛtyuñjaya Mahādeva.
inference: The presiding deity of this mantra is proclaimed to be Mṛtyuñjaya Mahādeva.
plain_english: Mṛtyuñjaya Mahādeva is proclaimed as the deity of this mantra.
